maintenance.reason: Alpha9.53 hardens the FoxESS commissioning boundary exposed by live Alpha9.52 proof. Commissioning now requires the dedicated read-only FoxESS export-limit sensor to prove the observed inverter export limit against KEMS' configured/DNO ceiling: an observed limit at or below the configured ceiling passes, an observed limit above the ceiling fails closed, and a missing, ambiguous or unusable authoritative readback waits rather than guessing. This proof reuses the exact deterministic FoxESS device and readback binding already used by command Shadow. The configured 6.4 kW physical/DNO export capability remains distinct from the transient active 0 W no-export command allowance, and Full-KEMS counterfactual export simulation remains unchanged. Shadow and commissioning diagnostic wording is now release-neutral. Alpha9.53 does not enable Control, commissioning completion, a real backend or any FoxESS hardware write; ready_for_control remains false, commands remain blocked and Simulate remains read-only. Alpha9.52 fixes the Shadow/physical control authority boundary exposed by live Alpha9.51 diagnostics. The Full-KEMS rolling optimiser remains authoritative for counterfactual simulation and may continue to model profitable battery export, but the physical ControlState now projects that target through live export permission and island state before it can become FoxESS command intent. No-paid-export or island operation clamps deliberate physical battery export to 0 kW while preserving house-support discharge, and the FoxESS command shadow independently fails closed if deliberate export is ever presented while grid export is disabled. The configured 6.4 kW physical/DNO export capability remains reported separately from the active 0 W no-export command allowance. Alpha9.52 does not enable Control, commissioning, a real backend, or any FoxESS hardware write; all existing command and commissioning gates remain closed and Simulate remains read-only. Alpha9.51 retains a bounded deduplicated history of completed Power Down sessions, exposes every completed session for the current local day on the managed KEMS dashboard, restores an explicit Power Down event-credit row to KEMS Daily costs, and makes retained completed-event bonus evidence authoritative for completed same-day customer reporting instead of continuing to show a stale in-event estimate. Completed-event figures remain KEMS retained results rather than supplier-settled Octopus cash. Alpha9.51 is reporting, persistence and presentation only: no Power Down joining, optimiser or dispatch decisions, tariff or SOC policy, commissioning, control eligibility, Ohme authority or FoxESS hardware-write authority changes; real hardware writes remain hard-blocked. Retained successor contracts include the Alpha9 coordinated parity baseline; Alpha9.13 forecast-aware scheduling; Alpha9.19 runtime Recorder hygiene; Alpha9.20 ShadowValidationRecorder Recorder hygiene; the Alpha9.22 startup hotfix at build_slot_flow for the unexpected planning_target_soc_percent keyword; the Alpha9.24 flow parity export-floor correction with its 15% planning/export target, independent 10% absolute floor and restart-safe 12% recovery latch; Alpha9.25 observability and reporting-only 7.0 kW cheap-window charge capability; Alpha9.27 reporting-only policy-label publication; Alpha9.28 staggered V2 flow while V1 remains unchanged and no optimiser behaviour changes; Alpha9.29 extra gap V2 packet spacing while V1 remains unchanged and no optimiser behaviour changes; Alpha9.30 solar-only commissioning; Alpha9.37 canonical current-day KEMS cost dashboard parity as presentation/reporting only with no FoxESS command/write authority changes; Alpha9.44 dashboard/observability only for Weekend Happy Hour with no Happy Hour scoring or joining logic changes and no FoxESS hardware-write authority change; Alpha9.45 reward normalisation where raw 6 reports 3 rewards rather than 6, the two-one-hour-reward event-day limit and 16 kWh-per-reward-hour cap, and it does not broaden external Octopus booking authority or FoxESS hardware-write authority; Alpha9.46 Solar Generation Today authority with telemetry gaps retained as discrepancy evidence; Alpha9.48 physical daily authority for Load Energy Today, Grid Consumption Today and Feed-in Today; Alpha9.49 Power Down dashboard/observability with joining unchanged and FoxESS hardware-write authority unchanged; and Alpha9.50 final managed dashboard composition preserving Weekend Happy Hour and Power Down presentation. All prior Alpha9 safety, reporting and control contracts remain retained.
